name: AO SMITH Intelli UV Pro
summary: A.O. Smith Intelli UV Pro is a premium UV + UF (Ultra Fine) + SCMT water purifier designed for municipal water supply.
intro: Enjoy safe, purified hot water with the A.O. Smith Intelli UV Pro. Featuring UV + UF (Ultra Fine) + SCMT Technology and India's 1st Dual Pass UV Chamber, it delivers advanced double protection against harmful microorganisms. With a stylish design, Digital Display, Night Assist, and instant hot water at 45°C & 80°C, it is the perfect addition to modern kitchens using municipal water supply.
